title: The three-way match
instructions:
## Procure-to-pay in the tables

Before an ERP pays a supplier invoice it matches three documents: the **purchase order line** (what was ordered, at what price), the **goods receipt** (what arrived) and the **invoice** (what the supplier is charging). An invoice line passes when the invoiced quantity is no more than the received quantity and the invoice price equals the order price.

Tables: **po_lines** (po_id, line, material, qty_ordered, unit_price), **goods_receipts** (po_id, line, qty_received; a line with no receipt has no row) and **invoices** (inv_id, po_id, line, qty_invoiced, unit_price).

## Do this

List the invoice lines that **fail** the match: `inv_id`, `po_id`, `line`, `material`, `received` (0 when nothing was received), `qty_invoiced`, `po_price`, `invoice_price`, ordered by inv_id then line. Use a LEFT JOIN to the receipts so missing receipts count as 0.

initialState.sql:
SELECT i.inv_id, i.po_id, i.line, p.material
FROM invoices i
JOIN po_lines p ON p.po_id = i.po_id AND p.line = i.line

hints: `LEFT JOIN goods_receipts g ON g.po_id = i.po_id AND g.line = i.line` keeps invoice lines with no receipt.
`COALESCE(g.qty_received, 0) AS received` turns the missing receipt into 0.
The failure condition is `i.qty_invoiced > COALESCE(g.qty_received, 0) OR i.unit_price <> p.unit_price`.

checks.label: The four invoice lines that fail the match are listed
checks.expectedQuery: SELECT i.inv_id, i.po_id, i.line, p.material, COALESCE(g.qty_received, 0) AS received, i.qty_invoiced, p.unit_price AS po_price, i.unit_price AS invoice_price FROM invoices i JOIN po_lines p ON p.po_id = i.po_id AND p.line = i.line LEFT JOIN goods_receipts g ON g.po_id = i.po_id AND g.line = i.line WHERE i.qty_invoiced > COALESCE(g.qty_received, 0) OR i.unit_price <> p.unit_price ORDER BY i.inv_id, i.line

checks.label: It uses a LEFT JOIN to the receipts
checks.message: An inner join would hide invoice lines that have no goods receipt at all.

realityNote: SAP, Oracle and Odoo all block payment on exactly these exceptions; the invoice-verification work queue an accounts-payable clerk sees each morning is this query.
